story_overview: Lyra, a daring sky-sailor with aviator goggles and a red scarf, seeks the mythical floating island of Zephyria. Guided by an ancient compass, she navigates treacherous storm clouds and sky-beasts to uncover a civilization forgotten by time.

video_prompts: Lyra stands at the helm of a flying ship. She looks at an old brass compass.
The compass spins wildly then points up.
first_frame_prompt: Lyra with goggles and a red scarf at the helm.
Hands holding a spinning brass compass.
speech: The maps were finished, they said.
But the needle always dances when there's magic to find.

video_prompts: Ship flies into a lightning storm. Lyra struggles with the wheel.
first_frame_prompt: Lyra gripping the wheel, lit by lightning.
speech: Legends are guarded by the fury of the wind.

first_frame_prompt: Lyra looking at a massive shadow in clouds.
Glowing sky-serpent rising above the ship.
speech: Titans of the wind don't notice us.
We are just leaves in the gale.

video_prompts: Ship breaks into sunlight. Lyra lowers goggles.
first_frame_prompt: Lyra lowering goggles in bright sun.
speech: Beyond the storm, the world finally opens.

video_prompts: Floating island Zephyria comes into view.
first_frame_prompt: View of a lush floating island with waterfalls.
speech: It wasn't a bedtime story. It's real.

video_prompts: Lyra anchors at a white stone dock.
She gazes at a clock tower.
first_frame_prompt: Lyra stepping onto a white dock.
Lyra looking at a massive brass tower.
speech: The air smells of ancient machinery.
A city where time stands still.

video_prompts: Lyra enters tower, mechanical birds fly around.
speech: These are the keepers of memory.

first_frame_prompt: Lyra's face lit by blue hologram.

video_prompts: She returns to ship, island glows amber.

speech: I found a key, and a burden.
